citations.claim: at first violating step body 3 overlaps wall 1 (distance -0.166) while moving upward at ~47.9 m/s
one step earlier body 3 was 0.72 outside wall 1 approaching at ~47.9 m/s, so per-step travel ~0.88
two steps earlier body 3 already at ~48 m/s driven by saturated controller, showing sustained high-speed approach

counterfactual.change: disabled the controller (enabled true->false); without controller drive body 3 never reaches the wall at high speed so no penetration

explanation: Controller-driven body 3 moves upward at ~48 m/s toward thin horizontal wall 1 (h=0.4 at y=11.6). Per-step displacement ~0.88 (dt=0.0184) far exceeds distance-to-wall (0.72 at step 31) so it enters the wall deeply within one step. Impulse plus positional correction with 30 substeps fails to expel it, leaving 0.166 overlap exceeding 0.15 limit. Disabling the controller removes the high-speed drive and the violation disappears.
vision_note: The red circle moves steadily upward toward the horizontal grey wall at the top through steps 29 to 31. In step 32 it reaches the wall and visibly overlaps its bottom edge.
